assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: English vocabulary learning card illustration in an existing gentle garden game.
Primary request: illustrate the precise meaning of the English noun "leaf" (叶子).
Subject: a single unmistakable green leaf with fine branching veins and one short stem, the entire leaf visible.
Scene/backdrop: warm off-white paper backdrop, sparse empty background.
Style/medium: hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture, clear bold central subject, soft natural muted green with restrained blue and coral accents only if needed.
Composition/framing: square image; keep the whole subject inside the center 70 percent, readable on a small vocabulary card.
Lighting/mood: softly lit, calm and inviting.
Constraints: exactly one leaf, botanical recognizability, no letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark or card UI.
assets.optimization: cwebp -q 82 -resize 640 0; no crop or content edit
assets.alt: 一片叶脉清晰的绿色叶子
